name: Maude

text.trigger: A non-exiled player's survivor finishes a search at the Grocery Store.
text.vignette: The freezer aisle still hums with cold, and one stocked shelf looks untouched since the last delivery. A faded hand-painted sign above it says take only what you need, and for some reason it makes the survivor think of Maude.

options.haul-it-home: Run it all back at once: the survivor moves to the colony without a move action and 3 food is added.
options.fill-your-pack: Stuff your own pack for later: take 2 food cards from the Grocery Store deck into your hand.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #6; SIMPLIFIED: the printed card also forbids playing food cards for the rest of the turn on the second option (forbid playCard would block every card, not only food); the second option draws the first 2 food cards of the deck
